acceptance_criteria: Every beat and shot names its game-state entry, visible information, dialogue or subtitle constraint, continuity preservation, and return state.
Each visual wave binds stable IDs, current prompts, current references, cost disclosure, named host-user approval, and continuity findings without treating generation as approval.
